_readme: Every folder under drafts/ must have an entry here. Statuses: pending (art generated, lesson not yet resolved - blocks new generation), scheduled (held for a future release_date), published, rejected-quality, rejected-duplicate, transferred (moved to a sister site). Validated by scripts/check-drafts-ledger.py; scripts/preflight-image-generation.py locks a slug here before any image generation.

porch-swing-with-cushion.note: Owner-directed 2026-07-15 corrections approved for publication. Early attempts were rejected for chain-routing errors; v2 was later rejected because it rendered seat boards before covering them with the cushion. The approved v3 near-front sheet reserves the cushion footprint in panel 1, draws only wood that remains visible around it, establishes both eye bolts in panel 2, adds two direct vertical chains in panel 3, and introduces only visible back slats with the cushion in panel 4. Rejected versions remain preserved in this draft folder.
